n-k-k1-01.title: Zvinyorwa zvina, chirevo chimwe
n-k-k1-01.goal: Sarudza zvinyorwa zvekirasi zvinotsigira chaizvo chirevo chechirongwa, uye taura kuti chii chakasiyana muchinyorwa chisingatsigire.
n-k-k1-01.material: Muchat yekirasi, Minho akanyora: "저는 화요일 오후에 한국어 수업이 있어요." (Ndine kirasi yeKorean musi weChipiri masikati.) Jina anoda kuchitarisa, saka anotarisa zvinyorwa zviri pazasi. Chinyorwa humbowo chete kana chichienderana nechirevo muzuva, nguva yezuva nechidzidzo.
n-k-k1-01.thinking.1: Kutarisa zuva, nguva nechidzidzo imwe neimwe
n-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Unoziva mazuva evhiki ne 수업, 있어요/없어요, 오전/오후
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Zvinyorwa zvipi zvinotsigira chirevo chaMinho? Sarudza zvose zvinotsigira.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa chirevo kuita zvidimbu zvitatu: zuva, mangwanani kana masikati, chidzidzo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa chinyorwa chimwe nechimwe nezvidimbu zvitatu zvose, kwete chimwe chete chinoratidzika chakajairika.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Zuva chete rinoenderana. Nguva yezuva nechidzidzo zvakasiyana, saka chinyorwa ichi hachitauri chinhu pamusoro pekirasi yeKorean masikati.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Nguva nechidzidzo zvinoenderana, asi zuva ndi수요일 (Wednesday), kwete 화요일.
n-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: A inotsigira chirevo zvizere (Tuesday, masikati, Korean). D inotsigirawo nokuti Tuesday masikati rimwe remazuva maviri akanyorwa. B inoenderana nezuva chete, uye C inoenderana nezvose kunze kwezuva, saka hapana humbowo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza CHINYORWA CHIMWE chisingatsigire chirevo (B kana C). Taura mumutsara mumwe (Chirungu chakanaka) kuti chii chakasiyana pakati pechinyorwa ichocho nechirevo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa chinyorwa nechirevo padivi nedivi uye uverenge chimwe nechimwe chidimbu nechidimbu.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Taura kuti chinyorwa chine chii, uye chirevo chine chii panzvimbo.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura kuti chirevo chine chii uye chinyorwa chine chii panzvimbo here?
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Note C is for Wednesday, but the claim says Tuesday, so the day is different.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 수요일이에요. Minho said 화요일, so the day does not match.
n-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.2: Nyaya B ikirasi yechiRungu yemangwanani, asi chirevo chinotaura nezvekirasi yechiKorea yemasikati.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.prompt: Shure Jina anowana nyaya imwe: "화요일에는 한국어 수업이 없어요." Ine mazwi 화요일 ne 한국어 수업. Inoitei kuchirevo?
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyaya inoenderana nechirevo here, kana kusaenderana?
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bvunza kuti nyaya ingaramba ichiri yechokwadi here kana chirevo chiri chechokwadi.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.a: Hairevi chinhu nezvechirevo, nokuti haipi nguva yezuva.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.a: Nyaya inotaura nezvezuva rose reChipiri, saka inosanganisira masikati.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.b: Inotsigira chirevo, nokuti 화요일 ne 한국어 수업 zvose zvinoonekwa.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.b: Mazwi anoenderana haakwani. 없어요 zvinoreva 'hapana', saka revo inopesana.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.c: Inopesana nechirevo: nyaya inoti hapana kirasi yechiKorea paChipiri.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.o.d: Inongoratidza kuti kirasi iri panguva yakasiyana.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.r.d: Nyaya inoti hapana kirasi yechiKorea paChipiri zvachose, kwete nguva yakasiyana.
n-k-k1-01.s.s3.explain: Humbowo hunotongwa nezvinotaurwa nenyaya, kwete nemazwi ainawo. 있어요 zvinoreva 'pane', 없어요 zvinoreva 'hapana', saka nyaya iyi inopesana nechirevo.

n-k-k1-04.title: Nyaya mbiri dzefoni imwe
n-k-k1-04.goal: Tsvaga kuti ndiani akaita chii kubva pamaparticle mumitsara mipfupi, uye ugadzirise danho rako kana mutauri wechipiri asingabvumirani.
n-k-k1-04.material: Vadzidzi vatatu vanotaura nezvenezuro. Sujin, Minsu ne Jiyeon shamwari. 불렀어요 zvinoreva 'akadaidza (munhu)'. Mumwe akadaidza mumwe, asi vatatu vacho havabvumirani. 제가 zvinoreva 'ini' (anoita chiito). 안 와서요 zvinoreva 'nokuti haana kuuya'. Verenga meseji imwe neimwe uye upindure; meseji inotevera ichauya shure kwekupindura.
n-k-k1-04.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa danho kana zvirevo zvitsva zvasvika
n-k-k1-04.prereq.1: Unoziva 이/가 ne 을/를 semamaka akapfava, ne 아니에요
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga meseji imwe neimwe, sarudza kuverenga kunoita sekwakanyanya, wobva waenderera.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga kuti ndiani anoratidzwa ne 이/가 uye ndiani ne 을/를 mumutsara mumwe nemumwe.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Usashandise nhevedzano yemazwi oga; tarisa mamaka madiki ari shure kwemazita.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 지영이 ndiye akadaidza, uye 민수를 ndiye akadaidzwa. Iyi ndiyo vhezheni yaSujin.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ane 이/가 (지영이) ndiye anodaidza. 민수를 munhu akadaidzwa.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 수진 ndiye anongoudza nyaya pano; hapana mutsara unoti 수진 akadaidza munhu.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana chinoti vakadaidzana mumutsara; unotaura mudaidzi mumwe.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 민수 (제가) anoti akadaidza 지영. Izvo zvinopesana nenyaya yaSujin, saka mumwe wavo akanganisa, kana kudaidza kwakaitika kaviri.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Vanotaura vadaidzi vakasiyana: mumeseji ya수진 지영 anodaidza, mumeseji ya민수 민수 anodaidza.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '아니에요' pano zvinoreva 'aiwa, hazvisizvo', uye mutsara unotevera unopa vhezheni yake.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hapana chinoti mazuva akasiyana; 민수 anopindura 수진 zvakananga ne '아니에요'.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Meseji ya지영 inotsigira nyaya yaani? (Nhevedzano yemazwi yakasiyana, asi tarisa mamaka.)
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 지영 anoti 제가 (ini) ndakadaidza 민수를. Izvo zvinotsigira vhezheni yaSujin. Vatauri vaviri (수진, 지영) zvino vanoti 지영 akadaidza, uye 민수 chete ndiye anoti zvinopesana.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mu '민수를 제가 불렀어요', 민수를 munhu akadaidzwa uye 제가 mudaidzi (지영 iye pachake).
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hapana nyaya, nokuti nhevedzano yemazwi yakachinja.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nhevedzano yemazwi haichinji mabasa. Mamaka 를 ne 가 achiri kuratidza kuti ndiani akadaidza ani.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Nyaya dzose mbiri panguva imwe chete.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Nyaya mbiri dzinopa mabasa anopesana, saka meseji haigoni kutsigira dzese.
n-k-k1-04.s.s1.reflect: Maka riri shure kwezita rinoratidza basa: 이/가 rinoratidza anoita chiito, 을/를 rinoratidza waanoitirwa. Nhevedzano yemazwi inogona kuchinja, asi mabasa anoramba akadaro. Kana vatauri vaviri vasingabvumirani, enzanisa kuti ndiani aiswa mubasa ripi.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.prompt: Zvino udza shamwari zvinotaurwa na Jiyeon zvakaitika. Nyora mutsara mumwe wechiKorea une rukudzo: 지영 akadaidza 민수. Isa 민수 pakutanga kwemutsara panguva ino, uye ushandise mamaka akarurama.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kuti ndiani mudaidzi uye ndiani akadaidzwa, wobva wasarudza maka reziita rimwe nerimwe.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Maka api anoratidza akadaidzwa? Isa zita iroro pakutanga kwemutsara.
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zita rapi rine 가/이 mumutsara wangu uye rapi rine 를/을?
n-k-k1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mabasa akaramba akafanana kunyange 민수 achitanga here?

n-k-k1-02.title: Chipfupiso chinotaura zvakawanda zvakanyanya
n-k-k1-02.goal: Enzanisa chipfupiso chipfupi neziviso yepakutanga, tsvaga mitsara inoshandura zvinotaurwa, uye uigadzirise.
n-k-k1-02.material:
Ziviso yerwendo rwechikoro iri pazasi, ichiteverwa nechipfupiso chemudzidzi mumwe kushamwari yaisavapo.

[Ziviso]
소풍 안내
- 날짜: 다음 주 금요일
- 장소: 한강 공원
- 점심: 집에서 가져와요.
- 물: 학교에서 줘요.
- 비가 오면: 학교에서 영화를 봐요.

[Chipfupiso chemudzidzi chiri panhanho inotevera.]
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.prompt: Chipfupiso chiri chekushamwari yaisavapo. Mitsara ipi inoti chinhu chakasiyana neziviso? Sarudza mumwe wayo.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pfuura chipfupiso mutsara nemutsara uye uwane chinhu chinoenderana muziviso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsara mumwe nemumwe, bvunza: ndiani anopa, kupi, uye rinhi? Enzanisa zvakadaro.
n-k-k1-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 nemutsara 5 hazvina kururama. Ziviso inoti uuye nemasikati kubva kumba (집에서 가져와요), uye kana mvura ichinaya kirasi inoona firimu kuchikoro (학교에서 영화를 봐요). Mitsara 1, 2 ne 4 inoenderana neziviso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva mitsara yechipfupiso yakanga isina kururama kuti ienderane neziviso. Shandisa chiKorea.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga chinhu chinoenderana muziviso pamutsara mumwe nemumwe usina kururama uye uenzanise zvakanyorwa.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakagadziriswa semutsara mumwe pfupi, uchitevedzera zvakanyorwa muziviso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu wemasikati unotaura kuti ndiani anouya nawo uye kubva kupi here?
n-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mutsara wangu wemvura unotaura kupi uye zvavanoita here?
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.prompt: Mudzidzi anoda chipfupiso chipfupi uye anosiya mutsara une mvura. Ikukanganisa senemitsara isina kururama yawakawana here?
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bvunza kuti kusiyana kuri papi pakati pekusiya chokwadi nekutaura chokwadi chakasiyana.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga zvakare mutsara une mvura wechipfupiso uchienzanisa neziviso usati wasarudza.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.a: Hongu, nokuti chipfupiso chinofanira kudzokorora mutsara wese weziviso.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.a: Chipfupiso chinogona kuva chipfupi kupfuura ziviso. Kusiya chinhu hakufanani nekuchichinja.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.b: Aiwa. Kusiya dimikira kunochipfupisa; chinongokanganisika kana chichitaura chinhu chakasiyana.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.c: Kukosha hakusi nyaya pano. Mubvunzo ndewekuti chipfupiso chinotaura chinhu chisingataurwi neziviso here.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.o.d: Aiwa, nokuti mutsara une mvura wakanga uri umwe wemitsara isina kururama.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.r.d: Mutsara une mvura wakaenderana neziviso; hauzi umwe wemitsara isina kururama.
n-k-k1-02.s.s3.explain: Chipfupiso chipfupi chakanaka chinogona kusiya madimikira, asi hachifanire kuashandura. Mitsara yemasikati neyemvura yakasarudzika nokuti inotaura chinhu chakasiyana neziviso; kusiya mutsara une mvura kunongorasa dimikira.

n-k-k1-03.title: Firimu rinogona kutanga nguva ipi?
n-k-k1-03.goal: Tsvaga nguva dzakawanda dzekutanga firimu dzinosangana nemamiriro ese emeseji, kusanganisira mamiriro anongoreverwa chete.
n-k-k1-03.material:
Minjun anotumira meseji kana kirasi yapera:

"수업이 두 시에 끝나요. 같이 영화 봐요! 영화는 두 시간이에요. 극장은 학교 옆에 있어요. 영화가 끝나면 집까지 한 시간 걸려요. 저는 여섯 시까지 집에 가야 해요."

Mubasa iri, nguva inonyorwa semaawa edhesimali pawachi yemasikati: 2.5 zvinoreva 2:30 uye 3 zvinoreva 3:00 (nguva dzese dziri masikati). Shandisa maawa akazara nehafu chete.
n-k-k1-03.prereq.1: Unoziva maawa echiKorea (한 시, 두 시, ... 여섯 시) ne 시간
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.prompt: '여섯 시까지 집에 가야 해요' inokuudza chii nezvenguva?
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kuverenga kwako nenguva mbiri dzekusvika (yekutanga neyapashure) uye utarise kuverenga kupi kunodzibvumira.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.a: Anofanira kubva kumba pa six o'clock chaiyo.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.b: Anofanira kunge ari kumba pa six o'clock panenge.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.r.c: Mutsara unotaura nguva yaanofanira kunge ari kumba, kwete kutanga kwefirimu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.o.d: Anofanira kunge ari kumba shure kwe six o'clock.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.r.d: Izvo zvaizova zvinopesana: mugumo mushoma panzvimbo yemuganhu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' inoratidza kupera kwemuganhu: kusvika six o'clock. Kusvika kumba kare hazvina mhosva, shure hazvibvumirwi.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nguva dzakasiyana 3 dzekutanga firimu dzinoshanda. s = nguva yekutanga firimu.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro ese emumeseji nemazwi ako: muganhu wekutanga, kureba, rwendo, nguva yekupedzisira.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza nguva yekutanga, wedzera kureba kwefirimu, wobva wawedzera rwendo rwekuenda kumba, uye uenzanise nenguva yekupedzisira.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.hint.2: Edza nguva yekutanga iri hafu yeawa shure kwekupedzisira yakashanda.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Shandisa awa rakazara kana hafu chete (semuenzaniso 3 kana 3.5).
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 수업이 두 시에 끝나요: firimu haringatangi kirasi isati yapera.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Wedzera firimu (maawa 2) nerwendo rwekuenda kumba (awa 1): aizosvika shure kwe six.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.explain: Firimu rinotora maawa 2 uye rwendo rwekuenda kumba rwunotora awa 1, saka nguva yekutanga pamwe ne maawa 3 inofanira kunge iri 6 panomwe. Kirasi ichipera pa 2, nguva dzekutanga dzinogoneka ndi 2, 2.5 ne 3.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura mumutsara mumwe (chiRungu chinobvumirwa) kuti nei firimu rinotanga pa 3:30 risingashande.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Wedzera firimu nenzira yekuenda kumba, uchitanga kubva ku 3:30.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa nguva yekusvika nenguva yekupedzisira iri mumeseji.
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakashandisa rwendo rwekuenda kumba mukufunga kwangu here?
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakaratidza huwandu (kutanga + firimu + rwendo) kana kutaura kuti aizosvika kumbaanonoka zvakanyanya here?
n-k-k1-03.s.s2.because.model.0: 3:30 yakawedzerwa maawa 2 inova 5:30, uye rwendo rwekuenda kumba runotora awa 1 zvakare, saka anosvika kumba pa 6:30, shure kwe six.

n-k-k1-05.title: Edza mutemo wemudzidzi
n-k-k1-05.goal: Edza mutemo wemudzidzi wakawanda uchitsvaga muenzaniso wako unopesana, uye utsanangure kuti unosiyanisa sei mamiriro maviri.
n-k-k1-05.material:
Hana ari kudzidza chiKorea. Akanyora mubhuku rake:

"If a Korean sentence ends in -요, it is a question."

Akaona mitsara iyi mudhayarogu: "뭐 해요?", "어디 가요?" ne "이거 얼마예요?" Wose anopera ne -요 uye ari mibvunzo. Zvino iwe unoedza mutemo wake.
n-k-k1-05.prereq.1: Unoziva mitsara yakapfava ye -요 nemazwi embvunzo 뭐, 어디
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara upi uri pazasi muenzaniso unopesana, kureva mutsara unopera ne -요 asi USIRI mubvunzo?
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Muenzaniso unopesana unofanira kupera ne -요 uye kuputsa mutemo.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga revo yemutsara mumwe nemumwe, kwete kupera kwawo chete.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.a: Iyi imubvunzo une izwi 뭐 (chii), saka unoenderana nemutemo waHana.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.b: Iyi chirevo, asi inopera ne -니다, kwete -요, saka haiputsi mutemo une chekuita ne -요.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.r.d: Iyi imubvunzo une izwi 어디 (kupi), saka unoenderana nemutemo waHana.
n-k-k1-05.s.s1.explain: '저는 학생이에요.' zvinoreva 'Ndiri mudzidzi'. Inopera ne -요 asi ichirevo. Muenzaniso mumwe unopesana unokwana kuratidza kuti mutemo wakawanda hauna kururama.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora muenzaniso wako unopesana: mutsara mumwe wechiKorea nezvezuva kana hupenyu hwAKO (usashandise mutsara uri pamusoro) unopera ne -요 uye unotaura chimwe chinhu, kwete kubvunza kana kukoka.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fungira chinhu chaunoita, unofarira, kana unacho, uye utaure nerukudzo.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Pedzisa mutsara wako nependero rine rukudzo -요 asi usashandise izwi rembvunzo.
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu unotaura chimwe chinhu panzvimbo yekubvunza here?
n-k-k1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Muparidzi wechiKorea angaupindura ne 'I see' panzvimbo yemhinduro here?
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.prompt: Saka muteereri kana muverengi anosiyanisa sei mubvunzo nechirevo kana zvose zvichipera ne -요? Ipa zvinongedzo zviviri (chiRungu chinobvumirwa).
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.hint.0: Fungira zvinoitwa zvakasiyana nemutauri kana munyori kana achibvunza.
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fungira zvinotaurwa nemamiriro nemhinduro inotarisirwa nemutauri.
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Chiratidzo chimwe nechimwe chingashanda mukutaura nekunyora here?
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.model.0: Mukunyora pane chiratidzo chemubvunzo, uye mukutaura inzwi rinokwira pakupera. Mamiriro ezvinhu anoratidzawo: anotaura anotarisira mhinduro.
n-k-k1-05.s.s3.model.1: Inzwi rinokwira rinoratidza mubvunzo, uye mamiriro ezvinhu kana zvinoreva mutsara wese zvinoratidza kana uri kubvunza kana kutaura.
